title: Inverted Boolean Condition in Access Gate
description: Gate checks 'if not is_valid' and incorrectly executes privileged operation on invalid status.

ground_truth.description: Inverted boolean condition in authorization gate: grants access when token is invalid.
ground_truth.explanation: Logic bug flips condition polarity, creating severe security vulnerability and improper state mutation.

expected_evidence.description: Access grant branch paired with negated verification check.
